articles.title: Trump Admin Sends Thousands of Mexican Deportees Through Central America

President Donald Trump's deputies sent more than 2,000 Mexican migrants back to their home country by flying and bussing them 2,000 miles to Mexico's far-southern border.

articles.title: Venezuelans, Cubans, Colombians arrive in African nation under Trump deportation deal
articles.summary: Deportees from Venezuela, Cuba, and Colombia arrived in Liberia as the West African nation agreed to accept up to 1,200 foreign nationals from the US over the next year.

articles.title: Terrorist attempts to stab IDF soldier in Jenin and is eliminated
articles.summary: Knife-wielding terrorist attempts to stab an IDF soldier in Jenin. The troops respond with gunfire and eliminate the attacker. No Israeli forces injured.

articles.title: Could This City-Beach Break be Morocco's Next Big Hit?
articles.summary: With a UNESCO-listed medina, Mediterranean beach culture and new direct flights, this slice of northern Morocco could become the country’s next big getaway destination.
